name: pdxui
description: Skills for building web app UIs with PDX (@pdxui) — the .pdx language compiled to Web Components, and its pdx-* components: the language itself, a component catalogue split by area with a page per component, topic skills (data layer, validation, routing, i18n, setup, testing), screen recipes (app shell, list/grid, dashboard, CRUD, master-detail), composing a screen, theming (a WCAG-AA theme from one brand color, 13 shipped themes, the semantic tokens), and the measured .pdx gotchas. The catalogue is generated from the library itself.
